text: This report provides the Debenture Committee with information on the City's new Sustainable Debenture Program. This new program consolidates, updates and builds upon the City’s previously established Green Debenture Framework (2018) and Social Debenture Framework (2020) and enables the City to issue Green, Social, or Sustainability Debentures. In addition, under this program, the City may be able to achieve slightly lower borrowing costs. To establish this new program, a Sustainable Debenture Framework (Framework) provides flexibility to finance eligible capital projects that deliver environmental and/or social benefits, while continuing to align the City’s debt program with evolving global sustainable finance standards and investor demand. The Framework supports the City’s leadership in sustainable finance and reinforces its commitment to transparency, accountability, and impact…
